@Auguste Poiroux and I took a look at spherepacking#248. The analogous work from the Gauss PR is in a different file than FG.lean:
https://github.com/math-inc/Sphere-Packing-Lean/blob/gauss/SpherePacking/ModularForms/FG/Basic.lean

It seems to us that the Gauss proofs are longer and more monolithic, and that we should therefore keep the shorter multi-lemma proofs in spherepacking#248 (which @Seewoo Lee has been reviewing, and which is hopefully close to being mergeable today), after which Auguste will rebase spherepacking#341.

(In particular it seems that Gauss didn't use the Ramanujan identities because RamanujanIdentities wasn't yet in the repo at the time it was cloned.)

It still uses Ramanujan's identities at some point (e.g. see here). But also it is true that proof is longer than I expected. But I'm still interested if there are some other codes under the directory FG that give us better golfed proof.
I added Draft PR#348 which golfs MLDE_G proof - @Cameron Freer could you take a look and probably reflect to your PR?
